inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger names both the English LRW benchmark (Lip Reading in the Wild, 500 words) and audio-visual recognition, classified by the audio input and the fusion design their full text names: raw waveform into a learned front end, or spectral features (MFCC, log-Mel, filterbank, spectrogram); concatenation followed by a recurrent fusion network, or attention/Transformer fusion; a pre-trained self-supervised or ASR front end. Boundary: LRW-1000 and other-language LRW variants are excluded; a study counts under every design its text names, related-work mentions included (upper bound); versions count once by key.
